# Bound each queue so a burst of messages blocks the consumer
        # (backpressure) instead of growing memory without limit.
        max_queue_size = 1000
        for i in range(num_queues):
            work_queue: queue.Queue[WorkItem[T]] = queue.Queue(maxsize=max_queue_size)
            self.queues.append(work_queue)

                worker_id=i,

                result_processor=result_processor,
                identifier=identifier,
                offset_tracker=self.offset_tracker,
            )
            worker.start()
            self.workers.append(worker)

    def get_queue_for_group(self, group_key: str) -> int:
        """
        Get queue index for a group using consistent hashing.
        """
        return hash(group_key) % self.num_queues

    def submit(self, group_key: str, work_item: WorkItem[T]) -> None:
        """
        Submit a work item to the appropriate queue.

        Blocks when the target queue is full, applying backpressure to the caller.
        """
        queue_index = self.get_queue_for_group(group_key)
        work_queue = self.queues[queue_index]

        self.offset_tracker.add_offset(work_item.partition, work_item.offset)
        work_queue.put(work_item)

result.oneSentenceSummary: `count()` upsampling misses aliased or whitespace-variant count columns
result.improvedCode:
def transform_query_columns_for_error_upsampling(
    query_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> list[str]:
    """
    Transform aggregation functions to use sum(sample_weight) instead of count()
    for error upsampling. Only called when all projects are allowlisted.
    """
    import re

    count_pattern = re.compile(
        r"^count\s*\(\s*\)(?:\s+as\s+([A-Za-z_][\w.]*))?$", re.IGNORECASE
    )

    transformed_columns = []
    for column in query_columns:
        match = count_pattern.match(column.strip())

        if match:
            # Simple count becomes sum of sample weights, preserving any alias
            alias = match.group(1) or "count"
            transformed_columns.append(f"upsampled_count() as {alias}")

        else:
            transformed_columns.append(column)

    return transformed_columns

judge.titleReason: The title states the defect: upsampling skips `count()` columns that are aliased or have whitespace variants.
judge.fixReason: The case-insensitive anchored regex on the stripped column rewrites zero-argument counts with inner whitespace or an explicit alias, keeps the alias and its case, defaults to `count`, and leaves other columns unchanged and in order.

result.oneSentenceSummary: terminate does not join commit thread, allowing commits after revocation

        self.shutdown_event.set()
        self.commit_thread.join(timeout=5.0)
